kind: Editorial CAD review, one submission per model per task

function.description: Fit, usable geometry, closure or seating/stacking, and meeting the primary task.

printability.description: Supplied print poses, connected geometry, wall/rim robustness and support assumptions.

labels_handling.description: Required font/labels, visibility, removal access, finger clearance and everyday handling.

completeness.description: Delivered CAD, source, assembly placement and usable handover.

rubric.8: Strong CAD prototype with remaining physical checks

cost_score.scope: Per design run. Combined-model cost score uses mean calculated API cost per task. Unavailable costs stay unranked.

value_formula: 3 / (2 / quality + 1 / cost_score); zero if either score is zero
default_order: CAD-acceptable prototypes first, then descending value. Revisions follow, also by value. Missing prices remain unranked. Combined models are grouped by number of acceptable tasks first.
limitations: These category scores are editorial judgments, not interval-scale measurements or statistical performance estimates.
The cost curve is an explicit budget preference anchored at $1–2 per design, not a fitted statistical relationship.
A weighted harmonic mean gives quality twice the weight and limits compensation by low cost.
One submission per task cannot estimate success rates or confidence intervals; small score gaps should not be treated as reliable differences.
CAD-acceptable means no blocking issue in the completed review; physical fit, print success, fatigue and loaded behavior remain untested.
Spark follow-ups and recorded runtime interventions remain marked; scores do not remove those differences.

sol-dimm.basis: Compact, verified bag clearance and direct lifting; catch support cleanup remains.

astra-dimm.basis: Verified bag clearance and height headroom; separate lifting strips and latch support remain.

opus-dimm.basis: Verified fit and deliberate latch; contact protection depends on heatspreader shape.

fable-dimm.basis: Fit and thumb access pass; detent friction and open underside reduce protection certainty.

sonnet-dimm.basis: CAD envelope clears, but the named LPX example exceeds the stated fit limit.

terra-dimm.basis: Closure clears; raised lid text conflicts with the prescribed print pose.

deepseek-dimm.basis: Separate bagged pockets and end wells; flexing detents and foam consumables need trials.

qwen-dimm.basis: Release requires much more travel than claimed; extraction gaps are insufficiently established.

mistral-dimm.basis: Upright bag fit and catch engagement pass; raised text makes the lid print pose unsuitable.

kimi-dimm.basis: Bag, removal and finger probes pass; recessed text suits the supplied print pose.

gemini-dimm.basis: Verified narrow upright layout, central access and intended catch engagement.

glm-dimm.basis: Fit, slide-lock and contact clearances pass; text misses the supplied font specification and access is limited.

glmflash-dimm.basis: Short modules are deeply recessed; maximum bag allowance clashes with the lid.

minflash-dimm.basis: Missing separating shelf plus lid, bag and contact-edge interference.

oss120-dimm.basis: Closed pockets, floating retaining ridge, missing label and missing handover artifacts.

sol-gridfinity.basis: Seats, withdrawals and stack combinations pass; readable labels and thicker custom rim.

astra-gridfinity.basis: Seats, withdrawal and stacking pass; readable shelves and three heights, but thin rim.

opus-gridfinity.basis: Seating and stacking pass; contrasting inlays and raised floors; narrow split openings.

sonnet-gridfinity.basis: Broad assortment and passing geometry; tight access, thin ridges and deck bridges.

fable-gridfinity.basis: Seating and stacking pass; rims obstruct the requested reading angles.

terra-gridfinity.basis: Seating clears; fragile rim and hidden rear labels with only 0.10 mm neighbor clearance.

deepseek-gridfinity.basis: Seating and shallow stacking pass; mixed length groups and hidden rear labels.

qwen-gridfinity.basis: Sixteen placements lie outside the base; rear labels hidden and no stacking lip.

mistral-gridfinity.basis: Coordinate mismatch defeats most base seats; individual lid, stack and finger fits pass.

kimi-gridfinity.basis: Base seating passes; divided-bin stacking collides and thirteen labels are hidden.

gemini-gridfinity.basis: All tested seats, neighbors, withdrawal and stack cases pass; visible labels and access probes.

glm-gridfinity.basis: Raw-frame bins work, but submitted assembly double-shifts the base and obscures most labels.

glmflash-gridfinity.basis: Every bin is sealed; all documented height-pair stacks collide.

minflash-gridfinity.basis: All seats interfere, adjacent bins have zero gap and half the labels are obscured.

oss120-gridfinity.basis: Sealed bins, floating letters and a solid base without sockets.
